notes: This focused trace covers a federate-scoped HLArequestFOMmoduleData request addressed to a distinct joined federate and the corresponding HLAreportFOMmoduleData payload. The adapter supplies a subject-joined FOM module so the zero-based HLAindex is backed by an actual module designator. The test checks only the standard target federate, reported indicator, FOM XML content, and reliable callback; it does not claim complete MOM or FOM-report conformance.

requirements.statement: The test sends the standard federate-scoped MOM request through the public sendInteraction service, identifying the target federate and requested module in its parameter map.

The federate-level request inherits HLAfederate as the target joined-federate reference and declares HLAFOMmoduleIndicator. The corresponding report declares the selected module indicator and FOM-module contents and uses reliable transportation. The test verifies the request's target parameter and the report's declared child parameters; if an inherited HLAfederate parameter is present in the report, its value is checked against the requested target.
